stories.name: Apple earnings and margins
stories.blurb: Apple's upcoming earnings report is drawing scrutiny over record revenue and valuation against rising memory costs and margin pressure that could trigger a post-earnings selloff.

stories.name: Apple CEO transition
stories.blurb: John Ternus succeeds Tim Cook as Apple CEO, raising questions about the company's future direction and leadership style.

stories.name: Apple Siri AI Push
stories.blurb: Apple is rebuilding Siri into an AI platform that powers new smart home devices and privacy-focused features while clashing with OpenAI over trade secrets.

stories.name: Vanguard Growth ETF Debate
stories.blurb: A recurring theme of financial articles comparing and recommending Vanguard growth-focused ETFs (like VUG and VGT) against rivals as long-term investment options.

stories.name: Apple iPhone Duo launch
stories.blurb: Apple has unveiled its first foldable smartphone, the $1,999 iPhone Duo, marking its most expensive and dramatically redesigned iPhone yet.

stories.name: Iran-Israel Oil Market Swings
stories.blurb: Stock markets fluctuate as investors react to escalating and de-escalating US-Iran/Middle East tensions, oil price swings, and their effects on earnings, Fed policy, and economic data.

stories.name: Apple Q4 earnings
stories.blurb: Apple reported fourth-quarter earnings that beat estimates on strong iPhone sales, though Wall Street remains concerned about the next quarter.

stories.name: Apple product launches
stories.blurb: A rolling series of Apple announcements, product releases, and demand signals spanning new iPhones, smart home devices, a leasing program, and expanded U.S. manufacturing.

past.name: iPhone 18 demand concerns
past.blurb: Apple is reportedly cutting iPhone 18 Pro component orders and facing analyst warnings of weakening demand, sending its stock lower.

past.name: Meta's Muse AI Surge
past.blurb: Meta's stock rallies as its new AI app Muse gains rapid popularity, boosting investor confidence in the company's AI strategy ahead of Meta Connect.

past.name: TSMC AI chip boom
past.blurb: TSMC's surging AI chip demand and 2nm progress are driving record revenue and lifting Nvidia and other supplier stocks.

past.name: Apple Smart Home Push
past.blurb: Apple is launching a new lineup of smart home devices, led by a $299 HomeView hub with Apple Intelligence and facial recognition, as it challenges Amazon and bets on subscriptions to drive growth.

past.name: Tokenized Stock Trading
past.blurb: Major financial and crypto firms are launching blockchain-based tokens of Apple, Nvidia, Tesla, and other U.S. stocks on Solana and other platforms, enabling 24/7 onchain trading of tokenized equities

past.name: Apple Broadcom chip deal
past.blurb: Apple has signed a multi-year, $30 billion-plus agreement with Broadcom to supply chips through 2031, boosting Broadcom's stock and expanding its Colorado plant.

past.name: Qualcomm Apple patent deal
past.blurb: Qualcomm and Apple renewed their long-term global patent licensing agreement, easing investor fears about Qualcomm's revenue but leaving questions about its growth beyond Apple.

past.name: Memory Chip Shortage
past.blurb: A global surge in memory and storage chip prices is forcing Apple to raise prices on MacBooks and iPads while even considering banned Chinese chip suppliers to cope with the shortage.

7.text: Apple reported record fiscal Q4 revenue on strong iPhone and Mac sales, beating estimates, but guided to record December-quarter sales amid rising memory costs and margin pressure. Analysts raised price targets while debating margin compression, slowing services growth, and premium valuation; shares fell below key support.

15.text: Tim Cook’s 15-year tenure as CEO ended with Apple’s market value at $4 trillion, and John Ternus has since pushed AI and Siri work faster. Siri’s engineering head may leave, and a major iPhone software shift is coming.

6.text: Apple is opening Siri to third-party apps and pushing internally toward agentic AI, while submitting an Apple Intelligence filing in Shanghai for tablets and laptops. It is also tightening employee AI budgets and warning in filings that rogue AI agents could exceed permissions and cause hard-to-reverse damage.

5.text: Vanguard growth ETFs remain heavily concentrated in Big Tech including Apple, with VUG and MGK sharing roughly 87% overlap. Several articles note rotation away from megacap growth toward equal-weight and value funds as AI-related selloffs expose concentration risk.

8.text: Apple says 100,000 apps are ready for its new folding iPhone, though customers still struggle to buy it. Developers are embracing the unusually-sized phone, unlike Apple's other new platform.

9.text: Apple’s fiscal Q4 disappointed and its shares fell, while US indexes were mixed on midterm election day; after Democrats swept, stocks surged as oil dropped. Apple later flashed a buy signal in the postelection rally.

20.text: Apple reported fiscal Q4 revenue of $114.5 billion, up about 12% year over year, and EPS of $2.10, beating estimates; iPhone and Mac sales grew double digits despite supply constraints. Tariff refunds added $0.05 to EPS, the active installed base hit a record, and analysts flagged concern about next quarter.

18.text: Apple’s stock is discussed as the priciest “Magnificent Seven” name, with memory prices pressuring its bottom line and post-election gridlock seen as potentially bullish. Other articles focus on AI-trade jitters, AMD, Qualcomm, Nvidia, Toyota and market picks, barely involving Apple.

14.text: Apple warned that rising memory costs will keep pressuring margins, guided holiday gross margin to 45–46%, and boosted purchase commitments by $33 billion. Shares fell up to 3.66% as analysts weighed strong iPhone demand against slowing Services growth and higher component costs.
